executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $155.89 per resident day (40.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 2.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $213,386, 3.6% of the $5,949,550 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,036,715, $27.16 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $622,605 (60.1%), allocated fringe $113,574 (11.0%), non-wage costs $300,536 (29.0%). Raw food was $279,992 ($7.34 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $350,566, $9.19 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $274,090 (78.2%), allocated fringe $49,999 (14.3%), non-wage costs $26,477 (7.6%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $313,900, $8.22 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $255,288 (81.3%), allocated fringe $46,569 (14.8%), non-wage costs $12,043 (3.8%).
Missing data: cost years 2016, 2018, 2019, 2020 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

Cost year 2018 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; balance sheet does not add up; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2019 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2020 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
